zoe: quick unblock request 10m I'm putting the March relnotes together. Need a tiny migration example, a couple of SDK snippet fixes, and two link canonicalizations.
kal: which files?
zoe: start with sdk/js/embeddings.md, sdk/python/embeddings.md, guides/migrations/embed-streaming.md, and the draft changelog at /changelog/2026-03. Also any stray absolute links to marketplace.* should point to docs.redwood.ai.
mina: I'll sweep for anchors and absolute URLs. Found a marketplace.vendor.com link and a moved heading under guides/. Will patch.
zoe: great. For the relnotes please include a short BEFORE/AFTER code diff — devs parse code first. Keep examples tiny. Also add a one-line Known issue for Dedicated customers about routing fallback.
kal: drafting snippets now. Plan: replace streamCreate/stream_create with explicit non-stream calls + a small helper so users can copy-paste. Will include a BEFORE/AFTER block.
mina: replaced two broken anchors and swapped the absolute link to docs.redwood.ai/integrations. Pushed a link-only commit.
ops-bot: New PR created: #6012 by kal - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6012
kal: sample I'll drop into the relnotes (JS + Python):
```js
// BEFORE (streaming)
for await (const chunk of client.embeddings.streamCreate({ model: 'embed-old', input })) { handle(chunk) }
// AFTER (sync helper + explicit non-stream)
async function embedSync(client, model, input) {
  return await client.embeddings.create({ model, input, stream: false })
}
const vec = await embedSync(client, 'embed-new', text)
```
```py
# BEFORE (streaming)
for chunk in client.embeddings.stream_create(model='embed-old', input=text):
    process(chunk)
# AFTER (sync helper)
def embed_sync(client, model, input):
    return client.embeddings.create(model=model, input=input, stream=False)
vec = embed_sync(client, 'embed-new', text)
```
zoe: nice and concise. Add a one-liner in migration doc: "Turning off streaming can change token accounting; consider batching or prefix/KV caching (see Optimize -> batching)." Also add Known issue: "Dedicated: routing fallback may surface 503s for certain beta model variants; pin to stable models for critical routes."
kal: added unit tests that exercise the helpers in both JS/Python so snippet playground CI will catch formatting/regression issues. CI running.
mina: link commits merged into the branch.
ops-bot: CI passed for #6012 1 ready for review.
zoe: I'll do a quick editorial pass on the changelog text and merge if CI stays green. If anyone sees obvious wording problems ping me here.
kal: :thumbsup: watching for CI flake and will patch if needed.
zoe: thanks team. tagging the thread resolved after merge.
